name: Deskhush Search
author: jasonmad

sections.description:
For publishers and store owners who want better on-site search without replacing SearchWP, Relevanssi, or similar tools. This is not a lead or CRM product.

Free

  • Improved on-site search via WP_Query
  • Synonym management

Pro

  • Optional Meilisearch backend
  • WooCommerce SKU and attribute indexing
  • Zero-result and top-query analytics
  • Title weight, exclude post IDs, and boost post types
  • Hybrid/semantic search path (re-rank with your embeddings API key)

Free never requires Meilisearch.

This Free package is fully usable on its own. Pro is distributed separately via Freemius.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the Plugins screen
  3. Open Deskhush Search in the dashboard
sections.faq:
Does this support WordPress Multisite?

Not in v1. The plugin activates on Multisite without errors, then shows an admin notice and does not run search interception. Use a single-site install for the supported experience.

Will this conflict with SearchWP or Relevanssi?

Yes, if multiple plugins intercept search. Disable competing search plugins or expect conflicts.

How does ranking work (Free)?

Free search expands your query with synonym groups, then runs an improved WP_Query across enabled post types (title, excerpt, and content). Pro adds title weight, excluded IDs, post-type boosts, optional Meilisearch, and semantic re-ranking with your API key.
